infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow MODUS to use the microphone for voice input in chat.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow MODUS to use your location for local weather in your briefing.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow MODUS to access your photos so you can attach images in chat and let MODUS search your library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow MODUS to save photos to your library.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Allow MODUS to access your contacts for relationship tracking and follow-up nudges.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Allow MODUS to read your steps and sleep data for your morning briefing.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: MODUS does not write to your health data.
